citations.context: Why does the text focus on Rahab and her family as the only ones who escaped Jericho? Why does she tell the spies that all the people living in the land are terrified of the Israelites if they are in no actual danger? That's Joshua 2, verses 9 and 11. Was the command to commit all things in Jericho under the ban, chapter 7, verse 1, only hyperbolic? If so, why was Achan and his entire household killed? Finally, did Saul hear a similar command from Yahweh through Samuel?
